job.text: What share of donations did Mrs. Jones and the Chetley Family give between them?

insight.important: Mrs. Jones and the Chetley Family gave over 40% of all donations between them

title.text: Mrs. Jones and the Chetley Family Gave Over 40%

source.shows: a subtotal stated as a fraction, for an audience averse to pies: a 100 % stacked bar instead of the pie (R7-08, R7-40, G1.37, G1.40, D-39); the two parts it sums together at the base although neither is the largest, in their strong shades, the others paled (R7-08, D-26 (b), D-9), so that the subtotal is one length from the base; each share before its part's name, five values against six scale labels (G2.18)
